subject.title: [Bug] OpenClaw UI WebSocket reconnect 导致会话 terminated

question: Should this report be kept tied to the WebChat active-run recovery contract tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90755, or split the reconnect-independent `terminated` symptom into a narrower follow-up?
rationale: Current source shows partial reconnect recovery but not full in-flight response adoption, and issue discussion indicates at least one termination path may not be caused by WebSocket reconnects.

options.title: Use the canonical WebChat recovery contract
options.body: Keep this open until the `inFlightRun`/active-run projection is adopted by Control UI with real browser reconnect proof, then close or narrow this issue based on the remaining termination evidence.

options.title: Split non-reconnect termination
options.body: Create or identify a separate issue for `error=terminated` without WebSocket reconnect while this issue tracks only reconnect recovery.

options.title: Accept partial mitigation
options.body: Treat current Stop visibility, queued-send retry, and history refresh behavior as sufficient, leaving any future lost-response reports to new issues.

recommendation.title: Use the canonical WebChat recovery contract
recommendation.body: Keep this open until the `inFlightRun`/active-run projection is adopted by Control UI with real browser reconnect proof, then close or narrow this issue based on the remaining termination evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available decision owner from the related in-flight recovery maintainer context and recent Control UI/protocol history.
